brief:
Israeli military reinforcements entered the village of Saeer north of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation involved additional troops moving into the area, though details on the size of the deployment or its stated objective were not immediately clear.

The incursion marks another instance of Israeli military activity in the northern Hebron district, an area that has experienced repeated operations in recent months.
title: Israeli forces storm Saeer village north of Hebron with military reinforcements
